about: Golden vectors for core/valuation.py (PA3). A row is the part of a HoldingRow that the sums read; every figure is computed with exact fractions by make_pa3.py, which imports nothing from sudarshan, and equals the number worked out by hand in the case's why. Rows, tabs, closed, previous_close and modes are one function each; replays are the phone's ticks frame by frame.

rows.title: Today counts what was bought today from the price paid
rows.why: 10 shares at the open, previous close 1,400.00, and 5 more bought today for 7,100.00 (710000 paise). Now 15 shares at 1,428.25: value 15 x 1,428.25 = 21,423.75 (2142375). The open was worth 10 x 1,400.00 = 14,000.00 (1400000) and 710000 went in, so the base is 2110000 and Today is 2142375 - 2110000 = 32375, +323.75, which is 1.5344% of the base. Cost: the 10 at 1,300.00 (1300000) and the 5 at 710000 make 2010000, so the gain is 132375 (6.5858%).

rows.title: Today counts what was sold today from the price received
rows.why: 10 shares at the open, previous close 100.00, and 4 sold today for 420.00 (42000). Now 6 at 104.00: value 624.00 (62400). The open was worth 1,000.00 (100000) and 42000 came out, so Today is 62400 - (100000 - 42000) = 4400, +44.00, which is 4.4000% of 100000. The 6 left cost 540.00 (54000): gain 8400, 15.5556%.

rows.title: Unrealised is value less the cost, charges included
rows.why: 10 shares that cost 1,020.00 (1000.00 and 20.00 charges, 102000) at 110.00 are worth 1,100.00 (110000): unrealised +80.00 (8000), 7.8431% of the cost. Previous close 109.00 and no trades today: Today 110000 - 109000 = 1000, +10.00, 0.9174% of 109000.

rows.title: No previous close: Today is not known, never 0
rows.why: Units were held at the open but the close before today is not known, so what they gained today cannot be worked out: the state is unknown and there is no figure. The value is still 110000.

rows.title: Units bought today need no previous close
rows.why: 5 shares bought today for 7,100.00 (710000) and nothing held at the open: Today needs only the price. Now 5 x 1,428.25 = 7,141.25 (714125); 714125 - 710000 = 4125, +41.25, 0.5810% of 710000. The missing previous close does not matter, since nothing was held before today.

rows.title: No price yet: counted at cost, Today not known
rows.why: 10 shares are held but nothing has priced them. The row is counted at its cost, 102000, so the tab does not lose the whole holding from its value; there is no gain figure (it would be 0 by construction) and Today is unknown.

rows.title: A holding sold out today still has a Today, and needs no price
rows.why: 10 shares at the open (previous close 100.00, 100000) all sold today for 1,050.00 (105000). Nothing is held now, so no price is needed: Today is 0 - (100000 - 105000) = +5000, +50.00, 5.0000% of 100000.

rows.title: A fund whose NAV is dated today has a Today, each value rounded on its own
rows.why: 109.459 units at the NAV of 45.6789 are worth 4999.96671, 499997 paise (design VA2). At the open the NAV was 45.5000: 4980.3845, 498038 paise (the .45 rounds down). Today is 499997 - 498038 = 1959, +19.59, where units x change would be 19.5822: each value is a whole number of paise before they are subtracted. 0.3933% of 498038. The units cost 481620.

rows.title: A fund whose NAV is not dated today waits
rows.why: The same units at the NAV of 45.5000 (498038), the newest AMFI has published, which is not today's: Today is pending, not 0. The value still counts.

rows.title: A value kept by hand has no Today
rows.why: 12.5 grams at 7,250.50 a gram are worth 90,631.25 (9063125); they cost 85,000.00 (8500000): gain 563125, 6.6250%. Nobody prices it each day, so Today is none.

rows.title: Lines are rounded one by one and then added
rows.why: Two accounts hold 3 units each of something worth 0.0017 a unit. Each line is 3 x 0.0017 = 0.0051 rupees, 0.51 paise, which rounds to 1; the two lines are 2. (Rounding their sum, 1.02 paise, would give 1.) Every sum on a screen is a sum of figures on that screen.

rows.title: Shares moved between two accounts today change nothing in the holding's Today
rows.why: Account 1 held 10 and gave 3 to account 2, which held 4: previous close 1,400.00, so 3 x 1,400.00 = 4,200.00 (420000) goes out of the first line and into the second. Now 7 and 7 at 1,428.25: 7 x 1,428.25 = 9,997.75 (999775) each. First line: 999775 - (1400000 - 420000) = 19775. Second: 999775 - (560000 + 420000) = 19775. Together 39550, +395.50, which is 14 shares x 28.25, what 14 shares would have made had nothing moved. 1.6618% of 2380000.

tabs.title: A holding sold out today is hidden, and its Today still counts in the tab
tabs.why: The only holding was sold out today (the VA8r row, +5000 on a base of 100000). The list has no row for it, but the tab's Today is the +50.00 it made: the figure comes from the fixed sums (closed_today). The row passed in anyway is skipped, not counted twice.

tabs.title: A stock, a fund waiting for its NAV and some gold
tabs.why: Value is the three rows added: 2142375 + 498038 + 9063125 = 11703538. Cost 2010000 + 481620 + 8500000 = 10991620, unrealised 711918. Overall gain adds realised 15000 and income 2500 and takes off fees 1000: 728418. Absolute return = (11703538 + 120000 - 11200000 - 1000) / (11200000 + 1000) = 622538 / 11201000 = 5.5579%. Only the stock has a Today (the fund waits, the gold has none): +32375 on 2110000, one row counted, one pending.

tabs.title: A holding with no price yet is counted at cost and said so
tabs.why: The stock (2142375) and a holding nobody has priced (counted at its cost, 102000): value 2244375, cost 2112000, unrealised 132375 (the unpriced one adds none). Today counts the stock (+32375) and leaves the other out as not known yet. One holding is unpriced.

tabs.title: Every holding without a previous close: Today is not known yet
tabs.why: The only holding has no previous close, so nothing is counted: the state is unknown with no figure and one holding left out.

tabs.title: Only a fund waiting for its NAV: Today is pending
tabs.why: Nothing is counted and nothing is unknown, one fund waits: the state is pending.

tabs.title: Only a value kept by hand: no Today
tabs.why: Gold priced by hand has no Today, and neither has a tab made of it.

tabs.title: A sold-out holding with no previous close leaves a figure from the rest
tabs.why: The stock counts (+32375 on 2110000). Something sold out today had no previous close, so the closed figure is None and contributes nothing: the tab's Today is the stock's alone, and the screen says a holding sold today is not in it.

tabs.title: Nothing else to count and a sold-out holding with no previous close
tabs.why: With no listed holding in the list and the closed figure unknown the state is unknown.

tabs.title: A closed holding counts even when the rest waits for a NAV
tabs.why: The fund waits (pending) and a stock sold out today made +5000 on 100000: the state is ok with that figure, and the fund is still counted as pending.

tabs.title: A sold-out holding worth less than half a paisa at the open still counts what it sold for
tabs.why: A millionth of a share at the open is worth next to nothing at a close of 1.00 (0 paise), so the closed holding's base is 0, but the 50 paise it was sold for are real money: the tab's Today is +50 with no percentage (there is nothing to divide by), not the 0 of a day with nothing sold.

tabs.title: The tab adds rows that were rounded one by one
tabs.why: Two rows, each a line of 3 units worth 0.51 paise: 1 and 1, 2 in all. Rounding the 1.02 of their sum would give 1.

tabs.title: Absolute return before the first anniversary (design X3)
A tab that sold everything still has a return (design X5)
Nothing put in: no absolute return
tabs.why: With no money in and no fees there is nothing to divide by, so the return is absent.

tabs.title: Fees count as money put in
A loss has a plain minus

closed.title: A holding still held is not a closed one
closed.why: The stock still held (VA3) is left to the list; only the sold-out holding counts.

closed.title: A sold-out holding with units at the open and no previous close
closed.why: Its Today cannot be worked out, so there is no closed figure at all (None), not a sum with a holding missing from it.

closed.title: A fund waiting for its NAV is left out
closed.why: The fund (pending) is not counted, as in the list; the stock sold out counts.

closed.title: Two holdings sold out add up
closed.why: The first +5000 on 100000. The second: 5 shares at the open (previous close 98.00, 49000) sold for 515.00 (51500): 0 - (49000 - 51500) = +2500 on 49000. Together +7500 on 149000.

closed.title: Bought and sold the same day: no previous close needed
closed.why: Nothing was held at the open: 100000 in, 101000 out, +1000 on a base of 100000, with no previous close at all.

closed.title: A holding worth less than half a paisa at the open
closed.why: A millionth of a share at a close of 1.00 is 0 paise, so the base is 0, and it was sold for 50 paise: +50 on 0. The figure stays, with nothing to divide by.

closed.title: Nothing sold out
closed.why: A tab with only holdings still held has no closed figure: 0 on 0.

previous_close.why: A price from today's session is measured from the close the tick carries.
A price from an earlier session is itself the close: Today is only today's trades.
On a Saturday, Friday's price is the previous close.
With no price the close that was given is kept.
A price with no day cannot be called earlier: the close given is kept.
An earlier price with no close given is the close.
Today's price with no close given leaves it unknown.

modes.why: A listed stock always has a Today.
Whatever the price is, a listed stock has a Today.
A fund with the NAV of today has one.
A fund whose newest NAV is yesterday's waits for AMFI (around 9 PM).
A fund priced by hand has none, whatever its date.
A value kept by hand has none.

replays.title: A morning of ticks on two listed holdings
replays.why: Before the open the price on hand is the previous close, so Today is only the effect of the trades: the 5 shares bought at 1,420.00 are worth 1,400.00 each now, -100.00 (-10000), and the 4 shares sold for 420.00 against a close of 100.00 made +20.00 (+2000), together -80.00 (-8000). Each tick then moves one price and the frame is the whole tab again.

replays.title: The previous close arrives with the first tick
replays.why: Two holdings have no previous close at first (Today unknown). The first tick of the first carries its close, the second's arrives later; each frame counts what is known.

replays.title: A fund's NAV is published in the evening
replays.why: A stock, a fund waiting for its NAV and gold. At about 9 PM the fund's NAV for the day arrives: its mode becomes ok, its price the new NAV, its previous close the old one, and its Today joins the tab's.
